mapper.insert: insert into t_replenish_suggestion (enterprise_id, product_id, calc_date, suggest_qty, target_qty, daily_out_qty, available_qty, in_transit_qty, safety_stock, max_stock, season_coef, status, create_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{productId}, #{calcDate}, #{suggestQty}, #{targetQty}, #{dailyOutQty}, #{availableQty}, #{inTransitQty}, #{safetyStock}, #{maxStock}, #{seasonCoef}, '0', sysdate()) on duplicate key update suggest_qty = values(suggest_qty), target_qty = values(target_qty), daily_out_qty = values(daily_out_qty), available_qty = values(available_qty), in_transit_qty = values(in_transit_qty), safety_stock = values(safety_stock), max_stock = values(max_stock), season_coef = values(season_coef)
mapper.select: select s.suggestion_id as suggestionId, s.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, s.product_id as productId, s.calc_date as calcDate, s.suggest_qty as suggestQty, s.target_qty as targetQty, s.daily_out_qty as dailyOutQty, s.available_qty as availableQty, s.in_transit_qty as inTransitQty, s.safety_stock as safetyStock, s.max_stock as maxStock, s.season_coef as seasonCoef, s.status as status, s.order_id as orderId, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, p.unit as unit from t_replenish_suggestion s inner join t_product p on p.product_id = s.product_id where s.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and s.suggestion_id = #{suggestionId}
mapper.update: update t_replenish_suggestion set status = #{status}, order_id = #{orderId}, create_time = create_time where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and suggestion_id = #{suggestionId}
mapper.delete: delete from t_replenish_suggestion where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and product_id = #{productId} and calc_date = #{calcDate}
